CustomField.description: Weighted score 0-100. Blank until all five metrics are populated and evaluation status is Ready.
CustomField.formula: IF(AND(ISPICKVAL(HIVE_Evaluation_Status__c, "Ready"), NOT(ISBLANK(HIVE_Volume__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(HIVE_Intensity__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(HIVE_Growth__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(HIVE_Recency__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(HIVE_Quality__c))), ROUND(0.30 * HIVE_Volume__c + 0.25 * HIVE_Intensity__c + 0.20 * HIVE_Growth__c + 0.15 * HIVE_Recency__c + 0.10 * HIVE_Quality__c, 2), NULL)
CustomField.label: HIVE Score
